set.body:
Problem
Public Mat.data aliases let a caller mutate a compiled design after a hypothesis is bound. Ordinary fit preparation reads the changed matrix but carries the old coefficient axis; LSS separately reads mutable event/baseline matrices.

Implementation owner: scalafim-design-identity (lead).

Contract
- Own a stable numerical snapshot at structural compilation using existing immutable Gale values; public compatibility Mat views must not expose retained storage.
- Make model/executor/LSS consume the same canonical snapshot. Reject same-shape source matrix/schema disagreement with a typed ModelError during model construction.
- No fingerprint/rank recomputation per voxel or chunk, no new solver or parallel analysis hierarchy.
- Preserve label-only compatibility and wrong-design rejection.

Acceptance
1. Reproduce input-array and exported-Mat mutation before the fix.
2. Shared JVM/JS tests cover schema input/output mutation, compiled hypotheses followed by mutation attempts, ordinary and chunked fits, LSS event/baseline aliases, and typed rejection of inconsistent source models.
3. Existing design/model/fit focused suites pass on both platforms in bounded sbt invocations, including DMS and structural inference.
4. Record exact commands and any unrelated gate failure; do not claim whole-epic release qualification.
set.title: Preserve compiled design identity under public matrix mutation
